_comment: USD per million tokens, Anthropic first-party API rates.
Source: Claude API model table (cached 2026-06-24) and prompt-caching docs.
A model id is priced by the LONGEST key it starts with, so claude-opus-5-5
never falls through to claude-opus-5. A model that matches no key is shown
with a ~ and priced at null (cost unknown), never guessed.
Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute TTL) or 2x input (1-hour TTL) on
every model. Cache reads vary, so each model lists its own.
fast: price multiplier when usage.speed == "fast" (fast mode).
